name_zh: 保护动作分量的低秩轨迹修复
formal_object: Trajectory matrix Uhat in R^(T x 3V); fixed orthogonal temporal projector Q including the anchor basis e0; residual Rhat=(I-Q)Uhat.

operations.input: Protected subspace Q and its complement
operations.condition: Q is fixed from allowed development/input evidence
Orthogonal residual lies in ker Q
Numerical decomposition error and rank cost are retained

derivation_steps.statement: Decompose Uhat=Q Uhat+(I-Q)Uhat into orthogonal components.
If Rhat=A diag(s) B^T, R*=A diag((s-lambda)_+) B^T.
derivation_steps.justification: The Frobenius/nuclear-norm proximal solution separates over singular values.

derivation_steps.statement: Set U'=Q Uhat+R*; Q U'=Q Uhat and e0^T U'=e0^T Uhat.
derivation_steps.justification: The nonzero left singular vectors of Rhat lie in ker Q; the anchor basis is protected.

assumptions: Low-rank residual is a model assumption, not evidence that genuine detailed motion is noise.
Q must be fixed, orthogonal and constructed without confirmation labels.
Anchor inclusion is required; adding a separate pin after SVT changes the optimum.
The full sequence must have an appropriate existing benchmark; no artificial looping is used for long-video claims.
method_expression: Keep Q Uhat exactly and apply singular-value soft thresholding only to the orthogonal residual, with a fixed development selection rule.
distinguishing_prediction: Protected motion components and the anchor survive exactly; unlike an unconstrained low-rank fit, native gains should not arise by deleting those components.
falsifier: Reject if the true motion lies in discarded residual directions or an equal-rank simple/unprotected estimator reaches the same official frontier.
closest_alternative: Classical singular-value thresholding; whole-animation latents in Mesh4D are adjacent prior art, not this estimator's novelty proof.
decisive_comparison: Base, unprotected SVT, protected SVT and budget/rank-matched truncated SVD; same native times, all scores and actual SVD cost.
operational_delta: Changes the estimator's protected subspace and residual prior; distinct from C02's projection of a prescribed geometry step.
feasibility_and_cost: T=16 makes a temporal Gram decomposition small; streaming the 3V columns is possible. Native Q relevance and effect remain unmeasured.
algebra_review_basis: Checked orthogonal decomposition, soft-threshold solution and anchor inclusion. No claim that low rank identifies true motion.
empirical_status: Not implemented in this round; no native method comparison or outcome.
originality_status: Unadjudicated. Classical tools and historical related code are explicitly attributed.
